name: Mai Tai
desc: Spiced rum and coconut rum shaken with pineapple and orange juice and a little grenadine.

source.title: Mai Tai
source.evidence: Same six ingredients (pineapple juice, orange juice, spiced rum, coconut rum, 1 tsp grenadine, 1 cup ice) and the same shake-and-strain method; Oasis uses twice the coconut rum.

ingredients.raw: 1 cup ice cubes, plus more for serving

steps: Fill a cocktail shaker with the 1 cup ice. Add the spiced rum, coconut rum, grenadine, pineapple juice and orange juice.
Strain into a tall glass full of fresh ice.
tips: Oasis uses 1 1/2 oz coconut rum; this version halves it so the spiced rum leads.
This is the fruit-juice party version. The classic Trader Vic's Mai Tai is aged rum, lime, orange curaçao and orgeat with no pineapple or orange juice.
